Gmail’s inbox filter scans only the first 12 words—questions, personal names, and urgency land in Primary. Salesy words get buried in Promotions. Test yours before sending.

Save this list-cleanup guide ↓
500 engaged subscribers beat 10,000 cold ones—Gmail’s filter rewards quality over quantity. Open rates, replies, and importance flags decide where your emails land. Clean your list every 3 months.

Save this Meta Ads checklist ↓
Meta’s algorithm resets your audience every 72 hours—after 3 days, your ad starts showing to strangers. Use Retention audiences, set a 7-day frequency cap, and exclude past converters to keep buyers in view.

Save this subject line checklist ↓
Gmail flags ‘free,’ ‘discount,’ and ‘urgent’ in subject lines—land in Promotions 60% more often. Use ‘complimentary,’ ‘exclusive,’ and ‘time-sensitive’ instead to boost open rates.
#emailmarketing #deliverability #marketingtips #crm #ecommercemarketing
